# rustinion_group_offline_alerts (Resource)

Manages a group's "device not responding" alert: a device whose agent hasn't reached Rustinion (command connection or checkin) for warning_after_minutes raises a warning, and a critical after critical_after_minutes. Portable, asleep and away devices are never flagged. The group's master alert switch must also be on. Destroying this resource puts the defaults back (on, 10 and 30 minutes).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The group these settings belong to.

### Optional

- `critical_after_minutes` (Number) Minutes without contact before a critical alert, 1-1440 and not lower than warning_after_minutes. Default 30.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Alert when a device stops responding. Default true.
- `warning_after_minutes` (Number) Minutes without contact before a warning, 1-1440. Default 10.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as group_id.
